content: Ketotifen is an antihistamine that has received FDA approval for the prevention of allergic conjunctivitis. It is not intended to replace professional medical advice or care and should be used as an educational reference only. The information provided is based on FDA package inserts, the National Library of Medicine, and clinical guidelines. Adult Indications and Dosage For allergic conjunctivitis in adults, the recommended dosage is one drop in the affected eye(s) twice daily, with an interval of 8 to 12 hours between doses. It should not be used more than twice per day. Pediatric Indications and Dosage For children aged 3 years and older, the dosage is the same as for adults: one drop in the affected eye(s) twice daily, every 8 to 12 hours, and no more than twice per day. For children under 3 years of age, a doctor should be consulted. Contraindications There is limited information available regarding specific contraindications for ketotifen. However, it should not be used if the patient is sensitive to any ingredient in the product, if the solution changes color or becomes cloudy, or to treat irritation caused by contact lenses. Warnings Do not use if you are allergic to any component of the product, if the solution changes color or becomes cloudy, or for contact lens-related irritation. When using this product, remove contact lenses before application and wait at least 10 minutes before reinserting them. Avoid touching the tip of the container to any surface to prevent contamination, and always replace the cap after use. Stop use and consult a doctor if you experience eye pain, changes in vision, redness of the eyes, or itching that worsens or persists for more than 72 hours. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. Adverse Reactions There is limited information available regarding adverse reactions from clinical trials or postmarketing experience with ketotifen. Drug Interactions There is limited information available regarding potential drug interactions with ketotifen. Use in Specific Populations Pregnancy: Ketotifen is classified as Pregnancy Category C by the FDA. There is no specific guidance on its use during pregnancy. Labor and Delivery: No FDA guidance is available on the use of ketotifen during labor and delivery. Nursing Mothers: There is no FDA guidance on the use of ketotifen in breastfeeding women. Pediatric Use: No additional FDA guidance is available beyond the labeled indications. Geriatric Use: There is no specific FDA guidance on the use of ketotifen in elderly populations. Gender and Race: No specific FDA guidance exists regarding the use of ketotifen in relation to gender or racial populations. Renal and Hepatic Impairment: There is no FDA guidance on the use of ketotifen in patients with renal or hepatic impairment. Immunocompromised Patients: No specific FDA guidance is available for immunocompromised individuals. Administration and Monitoring Ketotifen is administered ophthalmically. There is limited information available regarding monitoring requirements for this medication. Overdosage Information on ketotifen overdose is limited. In cases of suspected overdose or poisoning, contact the National Poison Help hotline at 1-800-222-1222 immediately. Pharmacology Mechanism of Action: Limited information is available regarding the mechanism of action of ketotifen. Structure, Pharmacodynamics, and Pharmacokinetics: Limited information is provided in the drug label regarding these aspects of ketotifen. Nonclinical Toxicology: Limited data is available on the nonclinical toxicology of ketotifen. Clinical Studies There is limited information available regarding clinical studies involving ketotifen. Storage Ketotifen should be stored at a temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). Brand Names Ketotifen is marketed under several brand names, including Zaditor, Alaway, Claritin Eye, and Zyrtec Itchy Eye. Alcohol Interaction The interaction between ketotifen and alcohol has not been established. Patients should consult their doctor regarding the effects of alcohol consumption while using this medication.
